project: JANUS P vs NP / Fundamentum / GPEI
failure_rules: A failed theorem attempt is retained even if later repaired.
A CI failure is classified as mathematical, implementation, harness, packaging, or infrastructure before any claim changes.
If a failure is only harness or packaging, the mathematical claim is not silently promoted; a separate correction event is appended.
A counterexample to a lemma or invariant is preserved as a first-class witness and must not be deleted after repair.
OPEN is a valid scientific result and must be journaled, not hidden.
Finite test success may be recorded as evidence but never promoted to a universal theorem without proof.
success_rules: Every newly proved lemma receives a named frozen artifact or a journal event pointing to its proof artifact.
Every finite frontier extension records exact scope and explicit non-claims.
Every successful CI run records the run id, commit SHA, and what exactly the workflow verified.
A stronger theorem does not erase the weaker predecessor; supersession is interpretive and append-only.
